Name: ANTIQUE_STAND_PARAM_ST
Description: Defines the parameters for relic vessels.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Standard row header flag: set rows are left out of the network test build. Appears unused by the game. Retail: set on 4 of 74 rows.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Icon of the vessel in menus.

Fields.Name: Hero
Fields.Description: Hero who can use the vessel: 1 Wylder, 2 Guardian, 3 Ironeye, 4 Duchess, 5 Raider, 6 Revenant, 7 Recluse, 8 Executor, 9 Scholar, 10 Undertaker; 11 any hero (the Grails).

Fields.Name: Relic Slot Color: 1
Fields.Description: Colour of the first relic slot: 0 Burning (red), 1 Drizzly (blue), 2 Luminous (yellow), 3 Tranquil (green), as EquipParamAntique Relic Color. 4 occurs only on third slots (Chalices, Forgotten Goblets); its meaning is not traced.

Fields.Name: Relic Slot Color: 2
Fields.Description: Colour of the second relic slot (values as Slot Color: 1).

Fields.Name: Relic Slot Color: 3
Fields.Description: Colour of the third relic slot (values as Slot Color: 1; 4 on the Chalices).

Fields.Name: Unlock Flag
Fields.Description: The vessel can be used only while this event flag is on. 0: always available (the starting Urns).

Fields.Name: Linked Goods ID
Fields.Description: EquipParamGoods item that represents the vessel.

Fields.Name: Depths Relic Slot Color: 1
Fields.Description: Colour of the first Depths relic slot (values as Relic Slot Color: 1).

Fields.Name: Depths Relic Slot Color: 2
Fields.Description: Colour of the second Depths relic slot.

Fields.Name: Depths Relic Slot Color: 3
Fields.Description: Colour of the third Depths relic slot (4 on the Forgotten Goblets and Chalices).
